title: Model quantization fingerprinting and safelist rollout
creator: Elena Cho
description:
Goal: Establish a model-specific 'quantization fingerprint' (signal profile) and a safelist of recommended FP8/INT8 profiles per model in the model catalog. Deliver an automated calibration workflow that produces a confidence-scored default profile, a CI/QA validation harness for accuracy drift, and a staged rollout (canary -> gradual -> global) with enforced fallback chains. The fingerprint will capture sensitivity across layer groups, activation ranges, and sample-wise error distributions to drive profile selection and runtime fallback heuristics.

Why: Many models exhibit heterogeneous sensitivity to low-bit quantization. A single global default leads to either missed cost savings or regressions in quality. Per-model fingerprints + automated calibration enables safer, higher-aggressiveness defaults and predictable rollback when accuracy degrades.

Scope: catalog metadata additions, offline calibration job spec, calibration dataset selection policy, validation harness (perplexity/EM/ROUGE + task-specific deltas), CI gating rules, telemetry for canary monitoring, and console UI flags for ops to override safelists.
acceptance_criteria: Fingerprint schema defined and stored as catalog metadata (JSON blob schema validated)
Calibration job generates at least 3 candidate profiles (fp8+, int8 symmetric, int8 asymmetric) with confidence score and calibration artifacts
Automated validation harness runs on canonical eval sets and emits pass/fail against configurable thresholds (example: generation model: <= 2% BLEU/ROUGE drop or <= 0.5 perplexity relative increase)
CI gating rule added: blocking merge if new model default profile reduces QA pass rate below threshold on primary evaluation set
Canary rollout automation implemented: automatic traffic shift and rollback when telemetry breaches thresholds for latency, token error rate, or QA-specified quality metric
Console shows recommended profile, confidence band, and one-click rollouts/overrides for Ops users
Documentation (Confluence) and migration plan for existing catalog entries completed
tasks: Design fingerprint schema (layer groups, activation histograms, weight outlier metrics, sensitivity scores)
Implement offline calibration job that produces candidate quant maps and per-layer scale/zero-point suggestions
Create canonical calibration dataset selection rules and small-sample fallback heuristics
Build validation harness: runner for eval suites, delta calculators, and summary report generator
Instrument telemetry for canary: quality metrics, token-level error histogram, latency and op-counts
Add catalog UI fields and API endpoints for storing recommended profile + confidence band
Create CI checks to run calibration+validation for new model onboarding and PRs to model catalog
Run pilot on 5 models (mix of LLM sizes and decoder/encoder families) and iterate
